description: This is a Java interface for the Order repository, extending JpaRepository, providing database operations for Order entities, including a custom query method to find orders by user ordered by creation date descending.

classes.name: OrderRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing Order entities with custom query methods.

methods.name: findByUserOrderByCreatedAtDesc
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Orders for a given User, ordered by creation date in descending order.
